Desktop's compiled catalog lists zm's profiles with `doctor`, which every zm answers. `session list` came in zoom-cli 0.81.0, so a catalog entry pointing there would fail on every zm installed before it; an installed zm's own answer replaces it once wirecat-desktop #476 lands.

Desktop's compiled catalog lists zm's profiles with `doctor`, which every zm answers. `session list` came in zoom-cli 0.81.0, so a catalog entry pointing there would fail on every zm installed before it; an installed zm's own answer replaces it once wirecat-desktop #476 lands.
